    return np.sum(first*second,axis=-1)

    return dot_vectors(point-closest,point-closest)

def point_triangle_squared(point,triangle):

    normal=np.cross(edge_first,edge_second)

    height_numerator=dot_vectors(offset,normal)
    first_numerator=dot_vectors(np.cross(offset,edge_second),normal)
    second_numerator=dot_vectors(np.cross(edge_first,offset),normal)

    result=np.where(inside,plane_squared,np.inf)

def segments_squared(first_start,first_end,second_start,second_end):

def segment_hits_triangle(start,end,triangle):
